company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. Its website describes the organization as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

On AI, the site discusses the steady progress of AI systems and forecasts about artificial general intelligence. It argues that the United States should lengthen its AI lead by expanding, not weakening, technology protections, and identifies three priority gaps to close, including remote access. The site also comments that an upcoming Trump-Xi summit is likely to disappoint leaders of top AI labs who have called for urgent, coordinated pacing of frontier AI progress.

No products, litigation cases, or MCP servers are listed. Washington state records show 114 entries associated with the Center for a New American Security.
